image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Top panel:** A **categorical timeline dot plot** (scatter/dot plot arranged by category), showing presidents’ first election year against their highest previous position.
- **Bottom panel:** A **table with pictorial marks** (candidate headshots) plus numeric/text columns.

## 2) Layout techniques
- The visualization uses **two vertically stacked panels**.
- **Top panel:** Categories are arranged as horizontal rows; dots are positioned along a shared time axis. This is a **small-multiple-by-row / categorical layout**, not stacked.
- **Bottom panel:** A **tabular layout** with rows for position categories and columns for candidate icons, counts, and most recent election year.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Highest previous position of each U.S. president | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis / row placement in top panel |
| Date/year of first election | Temporal | Position on x-axis in top panel |
| Individual president identity (for selected labeled points) | Categorical/nominal | Text labels next to highlighted dots |
| President occurrence / one president per mark | Categorical/nominal (entity) | Individual dot marks in top panel |
| 2020 candidates | Categorical/nominal | Headshot images/icons in the “2020 candidates” column of the table |
| Number elected president | Quantitative | Numeric text in the “No. elected president” column |
| Most recently elected (year or “never”) | Temporal (year) / categorical for “never” | Text in the “Most recently elected” column |
| Highest previous position (table rows) | Categorical/nominal | Row labels in bottom table |
